developerknowledge_answer_query.rationale: Reviewed: generates a grounded answer from Google developer documentation without changing Firebase resources.

developerknowledge_get_documents.rationale: Reviewed: retrieves developer documentation without changing Firebase resources.

developerknowledge_search_documents.rationale: Reviewed: searches developer documentation without changing Firebase resources.

firebase_create_android_sha.rationale: Reviewed: changes the trusted certificate configuration of the selected Android app.

firebase_create_app.rationale: Reviewed: creates an app registration in the selected Firebase project.

firebase_create_project.rationale: Reviewed: creates a new Firebase project and associated provider resources.

firebase_deploy.rationale: Reviewed: deploys project resources, code, configuration, and security rules from firebase.json.

firebase_deploy_status.rationale: Reviewed: reads the status of an existing deployment job without changing it.

firebase_get_environment.rationale: Reviewed: reads the current CLI/MCP environment and active target.

firebase_get_project.rationale: Reviewed: reads metadata for the active Firebase project.

firebase_get_sdk_config.rationale: Reviewed: reads SDK configuration for a registered Firebase app.

firebase_get_security_rules.rationale: Reviewed: reads deployed security rules without modifying them.

firebase_init.rationale: Reviewed: initializes services and may overwrite workspace configuration that is later deployed.

firebase_list_apps.rationale: Reviewed: lists app registrations in the active project.

firebase_list_projects.rationale: Reviewed: lists projects accessible to the authenticated principal.

firebase_login.rationale: Reviewed: changes the authenticated Firebase CLI principal.

firebase_logout.rationale: Reviewed: clears the authenticated Firebase CLI principal.

firebase_read_resources.rationale: Reviewed: reads or lists firebase:// resources without mutation.

firebase_update_environment.rationale: Reviewed: changes the active project, account, project directory, or terms acceptance used by later operations.
